sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite animation expansion for original hand-drawn 2D dark fantasy insect game. Reference images are identity and style references only, NOT desired grid or background. Preserve exact character identity, proportions, costume, palette, clean ink and painterly material textures. Pure side view all living frames facing RIGHT. Transparent real alpha background, no backdrop, ground, shadows, labels, text, borders, particles, panels. Each equal cell contains exactly one COMPLETE character including every antenna, blade and robe, with ample transparent gutter. Fixed body scale and centered pelvis, grounded foot baseline at 90% cell height. Distinct redrawn poses with real limb and weapon articulation, never stamp, shift or rotate a whole copy. Character: Moss Bell Matriarch from references, ivory mantis mask, branched antennae hung bronze bells, moss and tiny white flowers over root robes, large engraved bronze bell torso and TWO long pale root-scythe forearms. Produce exactly 6 columns x 6 rows = 36 sprites, square canvas. Read LEFT TO RIGHT then TOP TO BOTTOM, index 0-35. Slots: 0-3 idle breathing loop with scythe and bell motion; 4-11 eight walking contact/down/passing/up alternating legs, robe drag; 12-15 four deliberate gathering/swing windup, scythes lifted; 16-21 six forward scythe slash progressing shoulder elbow wrist through impact and overshoot; 22-27 six controlled recovery and retraction back to guard; 28-31 four hurt recoil/compression/settle; 32-35 four death stumble, kneel, fall, fully collapsed on right side. Maintain SAME scale throughout; death intentionally low but full body. High-detail production-ready illustration.

All living forms facing RIGHT. Real anatomical articulation across each four-frame sequence, never exact copied poses. No scene, no floor, no shadow, no words or labels. Real fully transparent background.

qa.review: Source sheets visually reviewed; independent complete alpha components explicitly selected; merged characters and edge-clipped poses excluded. Source atlas and attacks unchanged.
qa.mechanical_packaging: Component isolation of authored source pixels, scale normalization and atlas packing; no procedural animation or interpolation.
